Authorization.description: The system shall enforce role-based access control to restrict functionality based on user permissions.

Session Management.description: The system shall manage user sessions securely, including automatic session timeout and logout.

Data Backup.description: The system shall perform automated periodic backups of critical data and support recovery in case of failure.

Performance.description: The system shall meet defined performance benchmarks for response time and throughput under expected load.

Security.description: The system shall protect sensitive data using industry-standard encryption and security best practices.

Usability.description: The system shall provide an intuitive and user-friendly interface that minimizes user training time.

Scalability.description: The system shall be able to scale to accommodate growth in users and data volume.

Data Validation.description: The system shall validate all user input to ensure data integrity and prevent invalid submissions.

Accessibility.description: The system shall comply with accessibility standards such as WCAG to support users with disabilities.

Internationalization.description: The system shall support multiple languages and regional formats for internationalization.

Compliance.description: The system shall comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements such as GDPR or HIPAA.

API Integration.description: The system shall support integration with third-party services through well-defined APIs.

Monitoring.description: The system shall provide monitoring and alerting mechanisms to track system health and availability.

Data Retention.description: The system shall define and enforce data retention and archival policies for stored data.

Error Handling.description: The system shall provide clear and appropriate error messages to guide users when operations fail.

Reporting.description: The system shall provide reporting capabilities allowing authorized users to generate and export data reports.
